units.source_text: 即使知道被別人喜歡，我好像也缺乏愛別人的能力

en.t: Even though I knew that others liked me, I seemed to lack the ability to love anyone myself.

units.source_text: （話雖如此，世人究竟是否具有愛的能力，我深表懷疑）。

en.t: Even so, I have grave doubts about whether people in the world truly possess the capacity for love.

units.source_text: 像我這樣的人，不可能會有所謂的「摯友」，我甚至沒有「登門拜訪」的能力。

en.t: For someone like me, there could be no such thing as a close friend; I did not even have the ability to pay a visit.

units.source_text: 對我來說，別人家的門比《神曲》的地獄之門還要陰森可怕，

en.t: To me, the gate of another person's house was gloomier and more terrifying than the gate of Hell in The Divine Comedy,

units.source_text: 門裡面彷彿蠕動著可怕的巨龍怪獸，渾身散發著腥臭。

en.t: as if inside it some dreadful dragon-like monster were writhing and giving off a raw, foul stench.

units.source_text: 這並非危言聳聽，而是我的切身感受。

en.t: This was not an exaggeration meant to alarm anyone; it was what I truly felt.

units.source_text: 我和誰都沒有往來，也無處可去。

en.t: I had no dealings with anyone, and nowhere I could go.
Horiki! It really was make-believe turning into reality.

units.source_text: 我決定按照留言上所寫的地址，去拜訪住在淺草的堀木。

en.t: I decided to follow the address written in the note and visit Horiki, who lived in Asakusa.
